facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She opened the door. Grandmother looked different. She felt strange. Something was wrong.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood arrived at Grandmother's cottage. She knocked on the door and heard a strange voice. When she went inside, Grandmother was in bed. But something was wrong with the way she looked. Her voice sounded deep and her eyes looked too big. Red Riding Hood felt a chill run down her back.
